text:
mai: quick ping 1 - new quant bring-up (q5-lite) shows detok drift on mixed CJK+RTL subtitle lines. float ok, quant detok sometimes drops space between han and hangul and flips parentheses on arabic segments.

omar: can you paste a tiny repro?

mai: sample input: "日本の 가리구 (السلام)"
float detok: "日本の 가리구 (السلام)"
q5-lite detok: "日本の가리구 السلام)"  # missing space + trailing paren flipped

lucy: that looks like tokenizer boundary change caused bidi context shift. which tokenizer version/config?

mai: redwood-tokenizer@v2.15, preserve_zwj=false, locale_hint unset. quant pipeline: q5-lite symmetric. token counts: float=14, quant=12 for that sentence.

eval-bot: tokenizer-smoke (mix_cjk_ar_1k) summary: v2.14 avg tokens/sent=15.8, v2.15 avg=14.3, pct drop>=2:8.9%, p=0.006.

omar: seems tokenizer heuristic in v2.15 is aggressive. lucy, can you try toggling the small-kana joiner flag?

lucy: toggled `treat_small_kana_as_joiner=false` locally -> token counts restored and detok parity improved. adhoc BLEU: float=30.5, q5-lite+patched=29.8, q5-lite+raw=26.1.

infra-bot: action: blocked q5-lite rollout until tokenizer patch merges. queued rebuild job after PR merge.

mai: opened PR #5110 with revert + added mixed-script subtitle tests to smoke harness. please review.

omar: also add bring-up gating: assert avg token delta <=0.5 on locale-mixed sets and detok-check Hamming <=12.

lucy: will add tests and run full BLEU suite post-merge. thanks everyone.
